title: 2000 AMC 8 Problem 6
statement: Figure \(ABCD\) is a square. Inside this square three smaller squares are drawn with side lengths as labeled. The area of the shaded L-shaped region is

solutions.text:
We can subtract out the areas of the top unit square, the bottom right unit square, and the top right \(4 \times 4\) square.

The shaded area in \(ABCD\) is therefore \[ 5^2 - 2 \cdot 1^2 - 4^2 = 7. \]

Thus, A is the correct answer.
hints: Break the shaded L into rectangles
A \(4\times4\) square minus a \(3\times3\) square also works
